newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle market $67 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle market $67 - USDA.

text.p: Trade slow in the Panhandle Friday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady.
Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 2,900 head slaughter steers and 100 heifers following weekly movement of 102,500 head.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 67.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100 lbs 67.00.
